prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A standalone isolated fantasy card illustration for WizardCard, requested 1024x768 landscape RGBA PNG. Match polished modern pixel art: obvious square pixel clusters, stair-step hard silhouette, discrete 3–5 shade planes, old brass, dark outline, teal magical inlays, carefully readable compact subject. All subject parts inside frame with generous transparent margin. TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENT background and all negative space. NO environment, ground, pedestal, scenery, cast shadow, cloudy glow, opaque rectangle, vignette or painted checkerboard. No text, numbers, letters, readable runes, card frame or watermark. Palette direction: dark #101923, brass #6D5035 #9B7448 #C49A5A #E0BE7C #F2DBA0, teal #174A4B #247475 #3CA6A0 #72D7C5 #B6F0DD, silver #68778E #A4B4CB #DCE6EB, coral #703244 #B74C60 #ED8A78, fire #B54E2A #ED8E3E #FFD181, muted violet #AD91D8. No excessive detail: strong distinct silhouette readable in a small card window. Subject: ARCANE RECALL. One open antique brass-bound grimoire with dark indigo cover and silver parchment pages, seen slightly above, centered. Exactly three small luminous teal parchment-shaped memory fragments curve BACK INTO the open book in a simple return arc, suggesting recalling knowledge and drawing new ideas. No writing on the pages, only abstract geometric tiny marks. One small teal diamond clasp. Balanced warm brass against cool silver pages. Main book wide and solid, the three hovering page fragments distinct and sparse. No eye, brain, heart, healing symbol, potion, surrounding library or circular portal.
